Mr. Schmid joined Texakoma in May 2023 following 10 years serving in operations and drilling engineering capacities at Denbury, Inc. At Denbury, Mr. Schmid had the opportunity to work with multi-disciplinary teams on drilling and production projects in CO2 and water floods across the Gulf Coast and Rockies Regions.
